dict.string: Magi reads the files in your Desktop folder so you can search them. It never changes or uploads them.
Magi reads the files in your Documents folder so you can search them. It never changes or uploads them.
Magi reads the files in your Downloads folder so you can search them. It never changes or uploads them.
Magi reads the files on a USB drive or other removable disk you chose, so you can search them. It never changes or uploads them.
Magi reads the files on a network folder you chose, so you can search them. It never changes or uploads them.
